description: Opus FF FF-parity-harness (reduced from runs/parity-20260927 starmie-vs-sand-owen random game 2, decision 3): a flinch on a target that has already moved stays on it until the residual, so a turn paused later for a mid-turn switch shows it. Incineroar Protects, Prankster Sableye uses Sunny Day, Excadrill's Iron Head hits Sableye (30% flinch), then Rillaboom's U-turn hits Excadrill and the turn stops for Rillaboom's switch (no midTurn choice): the paused state keeps Sableye's `flinch` 30% of the time. The engine skipped that roll (F18: no move left) and never showed it. Speeds 108 / 105 / 80 / 70: no ties.
